title: D-0051 cross-build identity re-execution: the divergent CEC2017 D=100 cells re-run under the current build, threads pinned
governance: D-0051 (executed and independently replicated 2026-08-27, kept as staging by decision); promotion reopened and ordered by the author 2026-08-28, recorded in D-0055. Verdict re-derived fail-closed at promotion from the staged bytes.

verdict.statement: On every cell where the archived leg and the round-one transplant arm disagree, the current build reproduces the transplant arm and never the archive; on every cell where they agree it reproduces both. The residual is a build difference, not a within-build instability.
verdict.method_note: run_campaign-style single-thread pinning is load-bearing; an unpinned re-run is meaningless at D=100.

supersession_note: Non-superseding and additive. Reads the frozen primary release (archived leg) and rev-rel-2026-08-26-dd42d37eb (transplant arm) without re-minting either.
exclusions: curves/, gen_logs/ and per-session console logs, per release precedent.
